apps.description: One entry per service, the name is the service name (cmd/<name>). Write `name: {}` for a typical service.

gateway.description: The single public entry point: runs on the edges, has no database and no redis.

route.description: Public: the gateway proxies /api/v1/<name> to the service. false for internal-only services.

database.description: Own Postgres schema, role and password (secrets.postgres.<name>).

healthCheck.description: The service polls /readyz of every other app, so port 8080 of the apps is opened to it (common).

readAllSchemas.description: The Postgres role reads every schema (pg_read_all_data), read only (admin).

values.description: Values of the service chart (replicas, resources, env, nodeSelector ...), merged over appDefaults.
